name: Isobutyl 3,5-diamino-4-chlorobenzoate
description: Isobutyl 3,5-diamino-4-chlorobenzoate (CAS 32961-44-7 ) is an aromatic diamine compound used as a reactive building block in polymer chemistry. Its dual amine functionality makes it effective as a curing agent and cross-linker in high-performance material systems. In polyurethane and polyurea elastomer formulations, it functions as a chain extender and curative, contributing to controlled crosslink density. This helps in achieving improved mechanical durability in finished parts across various industrial applications. Coatings manufacturers use it to develop chemically resistant protective layers where aromatic amine curatives are specified for demanding service conditions. It provides the necessary stability and resistance required for heavy-duty industrial coatings. In adhesive and sealant systems, it supports tailored cure profiles that balance open time with final bond strength. This versatility allows manufacturers to fine-tune the performance of their products for specific bonding requirements. The compound also serves as a monomer in specialty polymer synthesis, including polyamide and polyimide intermediates. These intermediates are frequently used in the production of packaging films and structural plastic components. Isobutyl 3,5-diamino-4-chlorobenzoate is supplied as a solid, typically in powder or crystalline form. It is available at technical grade for industrial polymer and coatings applications where high performance is a primary requirement. Packaging options generally range from kilogram-scale laboratory quantities to bulk industrial orders. Purity specifications are confirmed by certificate of analysis on request to ensure compliance with internal manufacturing standards.
